title: Getting started with noctune — web
tagline: Set up once. Then just record.

headline: Your first
day.
scenes.narration: This video covers your first day with noctune. After you sign in and accept the terms, the dashboard offers a quick setup. Choose I'll just record, and it waits for you as a checklist. Here, choose Set up now.
scenes.disclosure: Starts after sign-in · welcome prompt reopened

headline: How your notes
come out.
scenes.narration: First, pick the structure your notes are drafted into, such as a general SOAP note, emergency triage, a dental procedure, or a wellness exam. You can switch on any encounter, and edit it later under Templates.

headline: What the client
gets afterwards.
scenes.narration: Next, what the client gets after the visit. noctune drafts it from the same recording, and nothing goes out until you review and send it. Pick a discharge template, or Nothing for now.

headline: Then just
record.
scenes.narration: That's it. Start an encounter opens the New Encounter drawer with your templates already selected. Pick the patient, then record or drop in audio. The first encounter video picks up from here.

headline: Your name,
your inbox.
scenes.narration: In Settings, Account sets the name clients see on your messages and signed notes. It shows your noctune inbox address, and Auto-finish decides whether copying a note or sending a discharge completes the encounter.

headline: Invite
your team.
scenes.narration: Working with a team? Practice shows your clinic, its plan and seats, and who's already a member. Owners and admins choose Invite member, add an email, and pick a role. We'll cancel, so no invitation is sent.

headline: Where to
go next.
scenes.narration: Back on the dashboard, Finish setting up lists what comes next: your first recording, your own templates, a discharge, and your inbox. Each step links to the setup guide, and each has its own video in this series.
